_comment: Optional. Put your Azure app's Application (client) ID here before you build or share the launcher, and nobody using your copy has to set anything up: they just click Sign in with Microsoft. A client ID is not a secret. Never paste another launcher's ID here.
_discord: Optional. Your own Discord application's Application ID (17 to 20 digits, from the Discord Developer Portal) turns on the Playing Auroras Client status on Discord. Upload a Rich Presence art asset named logo to that app. Empty turns Discord presence off. Never paste another launcher's ID here.
